mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.paper_id AS paperId, p.name AS paperName, r.user_id AS userId, u.username, r.score, r.answer_json AS answerJson, r.correct_count AS correctCount, r.wrong_count AS wrongCount, r.start_time AS startTime, r.submit_time AS submitTime, r.addtime FROM examrecord r LEFT JOIN exampaper p ON p.id = r.paper_id LEFT JOIN t_users u ON u.id = r.user_id WHERE r.id = #{id}
